author: mary Jo Giesman
text:
Always a great experience with this company.  Ray was very nice to deal with, felt like a family friend rather than a repairman.

He took out our old sink top and installed a new one. Awesome job and very efficient.

author: Marie Renier
text: Excellent in every way! The scheduling was a breeze with the wonderful office lady and the workers showed up on time. We had multiple fixtures replaced and they worked fast, clean and were extremely polite. The price was reasonable and they even removed the boxes and trash for a small fee! We will hire them again in the future! Well run family business!

author: Alexis
text: From the call to the plumber I had amazing service. They weren't going to be able to make it out till Tuesday and I really needed peace of mind and to get my issue remedied to find out why my basement flooded. Jo took the time to help get me fit in same day and Lorin came was kind, efficient and thorough with telling me what happened. I hope to not need a plumber but when and if the time comes again, I will be using them.

author: David Yarbrough
text:
I called Father & Sons Plumbing about a sump pump problem. My sump pump had died and I replaced it myself but the new sump pump wasn't working.

It thankfully wasn't a big emergency but Father & Sons Plumbing was able to get someone out the same day, they quickly determined that I had received a dud replacement pump and were able to replace it with a new one the same day.

The service was fast, friendly, and reasonably priced. I would highly recommend them to anyone needing plumbing help.

author: Somer Johnson
text: HIGHLY recommend Father & Sons Plumbing!  We were selling our home and had a small issue with a tub fixture that needed to be fixed prior to our home inspection. They came out on the same day we called (even though it was a very small job that a lot of companies wouldn't prioritize), easily diagnosed and fixed the problem, and were so helpful and friendly! 10/10!
